## 67aae675d447

**Actionable finding A2 — every generated motif contains an opposite-corner pair, permitting a two-point bounding-box shortcut absent from the canonical data.**

Generator source SHA-256: `3406acbb2c2873b35b1349859dcdcaa70263634557e717349226d9d4211880a6`. Executed canonical rule hash: `e0f86f3cb6ab`.

`_motif_cells` always seeds one pair of diagonally opposite bounding-box corners before adding any other motif cells. The executable rival in `checks/audit/67aae675d447-diagonal-pair-shortcut/rival.py` therefore ignores all but a motif pair maximizing `|du|*|dv|`, infers the box from that pair alone, and renders its perimeter. Because the seeded pair spans both full axes, this shortcut matched Racket on **60/60 production draws**: 20 each for easy, medium, and hard. The retained source-bound evidence is `checks/audit/67aae675d447-diagonal-pair-shortcut/production-probe.json`, with exact seeds in `production-inputs-meta.json` and Racket receipts in `production-racket.json`.

Canonical training pair index 0 is validator-accepted but has source-local motif cells `(-2,1)`, `(-1,3)`, and `(1,2)`—no diagonally opposite bounding-box corner pair. The shortcut chooses an undersized box and differs from Racket at six target cells: `(5,17)`, `(6,16)`, `(6,17)`, `(7,16)`, `(7,17)`, and `(8,17)`. Reproduction artifacts:

- `checks/audit/67aae675d447-diagonal-pair-shortcut/input.json`
- `checks/audit/67aae675d447-diagonal-pair-shortcut/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/67aae675d447-diagonal-pair-shortcut/rival.json`
- `checks/audit/67aae675d447-diagonal-pair-shortcut/rival.py`
- `checks/audit/67aae675d447-diagonal-pair-shortcut/counterexample.json`

The isolated audit preset still passed its existing 120 tests and declared semantic gate (`checks/audit/67aae675d447-combined/`), showing that the current competitor set does not cover this construction-induced shortcut. I left the audited generator unchanged.
